definition.en: The right of every person to live their sexuality and to make decisions about their body, their relationships and their intimate life freely and safely, free from discrimination, coercion and violence, and with access to the information, education and health services they need.

en: No autonomous treaty defines them; they derive from the rights to equality, privacy, personal integrity, health and autonomy, and have been shaped in the contemporary international development of women's human rights, especially from Cairo (1994) and the Beijing Platform for Action (1995). The CRPD requires that persons with disabilities be recognised as holders of these rights on an equal basis: it protects their private life (art. 22) and their personal and family relationships (art. 23), and guarantees their access to sexual and reproductive health on the basis of free and informed consent (art. 25), in connection with legal capacity and support in decision-making (art. 12).

prefLabel.en: Sexual and reproductive health and rights
